# The slot erase after its fix

Milestone 3, 2026-10-20. [All run sets](README.md), [previous: First jobs over the socket](2026-10-20-1927-first-jobs-over-the-socket.md), [next: First workflows, attempt](2026-10-21-1412-first-workflows-attempt.md).

**Tested:** Whether the model server's slot is erased after a completed job and after a cancelled one.

**Changed since the run set before:** The model server's unit got an empty, read-only slot save path, so the erase answers ([PR 140](https://github.com/sindredg/ai-security-platform/pull/140)). The job program also refuses a task with template syntax or a leading command character.
